title: Romania's Twin Crisis: Fiscal Instability and Stubborn Inflation Squeeze… · 27 Aug
keywords: Romania, fiscal crisis, inflation, EU funds, coalition collapse, no-confidence vote, Eurostat, cost of living, Fitch Ratings, eastern Europe, EU economic policy, sovereign debt
notes: Romania is grappling simultaneously with a deepening fiscal emergency and a cost-of-living crisis that official data has yet to fully capture. A coalition under sustained no-confidence pressure is attempting painful budget consolidation while households remain among the hardest hit by inflation in the European Union. The dual pressure raises serious questions about whether Bucharest can hold its reform commitments together long enough to secure billions in EU recovery funds.
